newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK BLUE CHIP GAINS BOOST SAX INDEX UP 6.05 PTS.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK BLUE CHIP GAINS BOOST SAX INDEX UP 6.05 PTS.

text.p: 1520 GMT - Slovak blue chips closed higher in flat trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange on Friday, boosting the SAX index for the second straight session.
*Slovnaft did not trade, VSZ up 33 crowns to 600, Nafta up 170 at 1,470, VUB unchanged at 1,700
Slovak blue chips closed higher in flat trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Friday boosting the SAX index considerably up 6.05 points to 181.09 points.
Brokers said that while the market was showing signs of revival, higher-price expectations were keeping liquidity relatively low.
"Prices were rising today much more than liquidity," Jozef Cimra of ING Barings said. Only 866 shares were traded on the BSE's listed floor on Friday.
He added that after a good start this week, the market has probably stalled and now awaits further impetus.
Steel maker VSZ rose 33 crowns to 600 while oil and gas storage Nafta increased by 170 crowns to 1,470, but only 72 shares traded.
Overall volume increased to 1,347,802 shares, from 1,058,291 shares traded on Thursday, while turnover, boosted by direct trades, climbed to 1.11 billion crowns from 644.68 million crowns.
